_comment: The ONE place go.py picks params. preset.<name> = v1 params when that preset's bundle is used. new_variant = v1 params on a bundle built on the day (holdem_like: 2 hole cards, any 5 of 7; other: everything else). heuristic_v0 = params for the heuristic-tables v0 (rules engine). Defaults: cand_nlhe for nlhe (bot-upgrades), the rc1 params (ev_t3) for every other preset. Update when the per-variant winners are in.
